Bloomberg reports: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña stepped down Thursday after the collapse of a major commercial bank with ties to his government plunged the South American nation into financial and social turmoil. According to BBC, the move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

BBC reports: Pope Leo had previously quoted Dylan's work in the preface of a book warning against nuclear rearmament.

stories.narrEs: Euronews Español informa: Joshua Wong se convirtió en uno de los rostros más conocidos de las protestas prodemocracia de Hong Kong de 2014, conocidas como la Revolución de los Paraguas, y ha pasado por prisión en varias ocasiones desde 2017. De acuerdo con La Nación (Costa Rica), tribunal amplió la condena del exlíder estudiantil, que ya descontado casi seis años en prisión. Según El Comercio (Perú), la Unión Europea cuestionó la condena de diez años de prisión impuesta al activista prodemocrático Joshua Wong y exigió su liberación inmediata. De acuerdo con DW Español, el exlíder estudiantil Joshua Wong fue acusado de pedir a otros países y entidades que impusieran sanciones contra el centro financiero y China.
stories.narrEn: NPR reports: Wong was sentenced for his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law, in a case that critics say reflects the crackdown on the city's once-thriving pro-democracy movement. Bangkok Post reports: HONG KONG - Activist Joshua Wong, who became the ‌global face of Hong Kong’s pro-democracy movement, was sentenced on Thursday to 10 years in jail on a charge of collusion with foreign entities under the city’s national security law. Le Monde reports: Wong, a former student leader who became internationally renowned during the 2014 Umbrella Movement, was accused of foreign collusion, a national security offense. According to CNA, jailed since 2020, Joshua Wong will be 40 when he is released under his latest sentence.

stories.narrEs: Según Euronews Español, el juez Ismael Moreno abre una nueva pieza secreta del 'caso Koldo' para investigar presuntas irregularidades en la adjudicación de obras públicas. De acuerdo con Europa Press, la Audiencia Nacional ha ordenado a la Unidad Central Operativa (UCO) de la Guardia Civil que realice seis detenciones para la toma de declaración en el marco de la nueva pieza separada secreta del 'caso Koldo' que instruye el magistrado Ismael Moreno, que también ha reclamado información en Adif y la empresa Azvi. Según 20minutos, entre los detenidos también está una mujer vinculada al exministro Ábalos, Andrea de la Torre. De acuerdo con 20minutos, el juez abre una pieza separada para investigar presuntos delitos de organización criminal, tráfico de influencias y blanqueo de capitales.

De acuerdo con La Nación (Costa Rica), tribunal amplió la condena del exlíder estudiantil, que ya descontado casi seis años en prisión. Según El Comercio (Perú), la Unión Europea cuestionó la condena de diez años de prisión impuesta al activista prodemocrático Joshua Wong y exigió su liberación inmediata. De acuerdo con DW Español, el exlíder estudiantil Joshua Wong fue acusado de pedir a otros países y entidades que impusieran sanciones contra el centro financiero y China.
stories.narrEn: NPR reports: Wong was sentenced for his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law, in a case that critics say reflects the crackdown on the city's once-thriving pro-democracy movement. Bangkok Post reports: HONG KONG - Activist Joshua Wong, who became the ‌global face of Hong Kong’s pro-democracy movement, was sentenced on Thursday to 10 years in jail on a charge of collusion with foreign entities under the city’s national security law. Le Monde reports: Wong, a former student leader who became internationally renowned during the 2014 Umbrella Movement, was accused of foreign collusion, a national security offense. According to CNA, jailed since 2020, Joshua Wong will be 40 when he is released under his latest sentence.

stories.summaryEn: The UN’s peacekeeping chief warned on Wednesday that the withdrawal of “Blue Helmets” from Lebanon and Western Sahara risks leaving a dangerous security vacuum, while the Security Council remains divided over what, if anything, should replace them.

sources.title: UN peacekeeping chief warns of ‘security vacuum’ as Blue Helmets leave Lebanon and Western Sahara
Morocco say it remains committed to Western Sahara ceasefire as peacekeeping mission ends

stories.narrEn: Africanews reports: Morocco says it remains committed to the ceasefire in Western Sahara even in the absence United Nations peacekeepers. According to UN News, the UN’s peacekeeping chief warned on Wednesday that the withdrawal of “Blue Helmets” from Lebanon and Western Sahara risks leaving a dangerous security vacuum, while the Security Council remains divided over what, if anything, should replace them.
